Walmart is planning to offer free prescriptions and NICU leave to employees. These changes are timely amidst rising health insurance costs. The catch: it's one company’s initiative and may not be a widespread trend yet.
— via HR Dive

item.title: The Defining Challenge of Responsible AI Is Designing Systems That Preserve Human Judgment When and Where It Counts
item.description:
A report highlights the challenge of keeping human judgment central when deploying AI. This matters because relying purely on tech could dilute essential human inputs in decision-making. The catch: it's largely theoretical now; practical application will differ across companies.
— via MIT Sloan

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:
